draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Igatpuri! This hill town sits at the head of the Thal Ghat, and its station is a technical halt for every train going in or out of the Mumbai region.
draft.hungryLine: Igatpuri station is famous for its wada pav, idli and coffee, so grab some if you're passing through.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Look for the Golden Pagoda of Dhamma Giri, it's the town's landmark, then head out to Camel Valley and the Five Waterfalls.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Arthur Lake, a few km from Igatpuri, is huge and placid, surrounded by dense greenery.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The top of Tringalwadi Fort is shaped like a turban.

spots.name: Dhamma Giri Meditation Centre
spots.detail: Short drive · The Golden Pagoda and Vipassana courses founded by S.N. Goenka

spots.name: Camel Valley
spots.detail: Short drive · A rain-fed waterfall over a slope of more than 1,000 ft

spots.name: Kalsubai Peak
spots.detail: 35 km away · The highest peak in the Sahyadri ranges

legends.title: Protector of the Ghats
legends.body: Locals believe Ghatandevi is the protector of the Ghats. Her temple sits just past Camel Valley, with Tringalwadi Fort behind it.

tips.title: Come for the rains.
tips.body: Waterfalls like the one at Camel Valley are fed by rainwater, so they're at their best in the wet season.

tips.title: Lace up your boots.
tips.body: Trekking, hiking and birdwatching are the main reasons people come, with treks like Kulang gadh, Bitangad and Sandhan Valley.

story.title: The Buddha's technique
story.body: Vipassana, the insight meditation taught at Dhamma Giri, goes back to a technique the Buddha taught in India 2,500 years ago.

story.title: Egutpoora
story.body: Igatpuri was once known as Egutpoora.

story.title: A hillside cemetery
story.body: On a hillock north of town lies the Igatpuri Cemetery, where soldiers who died fighting in the great war are buried.

story.title: Changing engines
story.body: Igatpuri station used to be where trains swapped locomotives on the way in and out of Mumbai. Trains still detach banker locomotives or check emergency brakes here.

story.title: The Golden Pagoda
story.body: S.N. Goenka's Dhamma Giri centre, with its large Golden Pagoda, now draws people from across India and abroad.
